market_portfolios.how_to_read: Values are FantasyCalc dynasty trade values (superflex, 12 teams, full PPR). move30 = 30-day market move of the players held now (trade-neutral). since_change = change since the snapshot dated `since` (includes trades). sidelined = value on IR/Out/PUP. Status flags: crash, correction, stable, bull.

trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

Darkspaces.tagline: Commissioner, seller of Swift, and the recipient of the memo at 67.46.
file: A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.

Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year. In Week 7 he claimed Quentin Johnston for $1 after Hades9mm cut him.
Hades9mm, who said he would out score him and did, 124.02 to 67.46.
Whether Collins moves before the deadline, C33DeezNutzz in Week 9, and the 1.03, 63.26 MAXPF points above the 1.01.

Snipe58.tagline: The 1.01, a 62.62 floor, and a rare seller.
file: A win-now buyer who pays with the future. Stays out of the chat and lets the transaction log do the talking.
Quietly converting picks into veterans. Deebo Samuel cost a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson cost Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford cost two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB.
The bench and fumbduckdumbfuck. 35.6 stayed on a 56.3-point bench in the 101.68-point loss.
Zygon in Week 9, the 1.01 at 993.12 MAXPF, and whether a buyer who just took a 2nd keeps selling.

StealingGas.tagline: The top score again, two trades for backs, and the 1.09.
file: A self-declared tanker with a competitor's wallet. Announces the plan, then spends against it, and scores against it.
The announcement-then-purchase combo: tank declared in Week 2, $99 on Stribling immediately, then $298 on Jaxson Dart. In Week 7 he made four free moves, three of them in under four minutes.
The 0.6 MAXPF points between the 1.08 and the 1.09, and fumbduckdumbfuck, who is next.
fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 9, whether the dormant plan ever starts, and $98 of FAAB with a 1st and a 2nd now sold.
The algorithm manager. Builds the roster around production, then lets the numbers run.
Listing handcuffs on the block as a dare. Emmett Johnson and Blake Corum are posted with the line make me regret it when Walker tears his ACL.
The bench. 41.44 stayed on it in Week 8, with Emmett Johnson's 25.3 among it.
Snipe58 in Week 9, and whether the 1.12 and the highest ceiling hold.

Hades9mm.tagline: He said it and did it: 124.02 to 67.46.
file: A balanced, hand-built roster and a buyer's budget. Every one of his 23 picks was his own, which is the rarest thing in this league.

Selling a star for depth. The London deal moved Drake London for Quentin Johnston, Cam Ward, TreVeyon Henderson and a 2027 3rd. In Week 7 he cut Johnston for Jaylin Noel, and the commissioner claimed Johnston for $1.
The bench. 28.62 stayed on it in the win, and StealingGas, who beat him in Week 7.
Johnny4Skins in Week 9, and the 1.10 at 1332.36 MAXPF.

Johnny4Skins.tagline: Three quarterbacks out, and 126.4 on the board.
file: The league's most hands-off roster. Johnny4Skins drafted a few good players, then left the room and let the system finish the job.
Not spending. $500 of FAAB intact, and the only moves are free ones. In Week 7 he told the chat all three of his quarterbacks are out.
The quarterback room. The market feed lists Lamar Jackson Out and Jalen Hurts on IR.
Hades9mm in Week 9, the Jackson injury, and $500 of FAAB.

Sarge71.tagline: 1-7, the 1.02, and a bench with nothing to give.
file: A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
The depth chart. His entire 26.02-point bench would have started in Week 8.
YesChef23 in Week 9, the 1.02 at 1037.72, and a depth trade he has not made.

desk: Hades9mm did what he told the chat he would do. He beat Darkspaces 124.02 to 67.46 in the Match of the Week, a margin of 56.56, with Mike Gesicki leading at 17.6 and 28.62 left on his bench. Darkspaces, who had asked why his players missed the tanking memo, got the memo: Drake Maye led at 22.46, 15.0 stayed on the bench, and he fell to 3-5 and 9th. His 1056.38 MAXPF (the points a perfect lineup would have scored each week, added up, lowest picks first) still holds the 1.03, 63.26 above Snipe58 at the 1.01. He also sold D'Andre Swift to StealingGas for a 2027 1st, the first block listing to move.

StealingGas posted the top score in the league for the second week running, 173.6 against C33DeezNutzz's 119.94, with Bhayshul Tuten at 29.9 and 18.6 left on the bench. He is 5-3 and 2nd, and the week also had him buy two running backs with picks: Jonah Coleman from Snipe58 for K. Miller and his 2027 2nd, and Swift for his 2027 1st. Zygon is 7-1 with the highest MAXPF, 1417.26, and the 1.12. fumbduckdumbfuck beat Snipe58 164.3 to 62.62 for the biggest margin of the week, and Painty69 left 93.88 on the bench in a 49.42-point loss to Zygon, which put his 1339.8 MAXPF at the 1.11.

closer.label: The desk's last word
closer.text: A 2027 1st and a 2027 2nd changed hands this week, both out of StealingGas's pocket and both for running backs. Darkspaces sold a scorer, the only tank move the rule recognizes, and now holds the 1.03 and an extra first. The wallet that said it was dormant is the one still buying.

motw.desk: Two 5-3 teams with 1.08 and 1.09 slots 0.6 MAXPF points apart. StealingGas has posted the top score for two weeks and fumbduckdumbfuck posted the third-best this week. The loser falls behind the other in the standings.
motw.verdict: The desk leans StealingGas, 145 to 132, and treats the dormant plan as a Week 12 problem, not a Week 9 one.

drama_sample.p: Darkspaces asked the chat how embarrassing it would be to win, then lost to Hades9mm 124.02 to 67.46. Drake Maye led at 22.46 and 15.0 stayed on the bench. He is 3-5 and 9th with 950.6 points. The poll gave Hades9mm by double digits two of its four votes.
drama_sample.desk: The players listened and the slot did not. A bad score does not lower MAXPF. Selling the roster does, and Swift is the first piece out.
